faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi Project Associate-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the AIIMS Delhi Project Associate-II recruitment is 30th September 2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate-II post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a First Class Postgraduate degree in Psychology or Clinical Psychology, along with at least 2 years of research experience. NET/GATE qualification is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Associate-II position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Associate-II post is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per the government's recruitment rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-II role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Associate-II position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 45,500 per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, as per the provided data, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate-II post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Associate-II post in the All India Institute of Medical Sciences Delhi (AIIMS Delhi) recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Associate-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Associate-II recruitment at AIIMS Delhi will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The job for the Project Associate-II position is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location?
faq.answer: The job location for this recruitment is New Delhi, Delhi.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from other states apply for this post?
faq.answer: The notification does not specify any state-wise restrictions for application. Eligible candidates from all over India can apply for this post, provided they meet the eligibility criteria.
